description: Chat spots the safe code on a bridge postcard, Windah admits 'W Viewer', needs 5 digits, the safe opens and he gets a TCG card (idea C1). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-kode/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-kode.mp4): THREE parts of stream-1832-1932.mp4 (Windah live 03qhcshfeMY 'GAMEPLAY #4', file t 0 = 20 Nov 2026 18:32:03 WIB) re-encoded to 1080p30 and joined: part 1 local 0-14.5 = t 861.5-876.0; part 2 local 14.5-29 = t 892.5-907.0; part 3 local 29-45 = t 921.0-937.0. Cuts: P861 t 862.22-868.10 = local 0.72-6.60 -> output 0.00-5.88; P861 t 873.12-873.86 = local 11.62-12.36 -> output 5.88-6.62; P861 t 874.96-875.55 = local 13.46-14.05 -> output 6.62-7.21; P892 t 893.15-894.80 = local 15.15-16.80 -> output 7.21-8.86; P892 t 904.25-906.42 = local 26.25-28.42 -> output 8.86-11.03; P921 t 921.74-922.45 = local 29.74-30.45 -> output 11.03-11.74; P921 t 925.15-926.50 = local 33.15-34.50 -> output 11.74-13.09; P921 t 927.95-936.40 = local 35.95-44.40 -> output 13.09-21.54. Beats: 18:46:27 (file 14:22) chat spots the safe code on the bridge postcard: 'oh iya itu tuh, oh di jembatan, W Viewer! kali ini W Viewer, gue akui W Viewer'; 'eh 5 digit' (Windah's 'anjing' right after it, t 873.86-874.95, is cut, so is the repeat '5 digit guys'); 'tar dulu guys'; skipped the 4-0-1-7 attempts; 'gak ada digit ke 5, gak ada guys'; 19:00:07 (file 15:04) '4,4,0,1,7, let's do it bro' (the in-game button prompt 'PLANT EXPLOSIVE / ENTER CODE' is box-blurred for the whole cut; dropped 'ini bisa plant explosive juga ya'); then the safe opens ('kebuka bro', 'eh kebuka sendiri'), the Collectible Card (TCG) appears: 'NICE! Let's go TCG... orang pertama yang dapet TCG, Laki Mafia kah?'. NOTE: the hourly transcript's 'Ayolah, ayolok...' chant (15:15-15:54) is a whisper hallucination, nothing like it is spoken; the real payoff is the card. Dropped everything else (drug missions nearby, the 'anjing' at 14:33, gunfire before 13:21). Frames: trailer interior, safe, card, no guns, no drugs, no swears. Main 21.54 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Clean layout as windah-gtavi-sepatu; hook line 1 Paper 'CHAT LEBIH JELI DARI WINDAH', line 2 Volt 'KODE BRANKAS KETEMU WKWK', Audex 66. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
